unfold.correction_model: per-epoch, penalised second difference in time
unfold.gain_definition: dM_band / d(log10 L_nu at the node), finite difference on the assembled surface; -2.5 is the delta-band limit

band_admission.rule: one departure at a time, worst excess first, undone when it pushed a band that was inside the cap outside it

template.label: EP 260321a / SN 2026gzf (archetypal thermal X-ray shock breakout in SDSS J095942.88+002506.2)
template.z_source: Yuan et al. 2026, arXiv:2606.10014v2 (read in full), discovery: "An autonomous observation by EP's Follow-up X-ray Telescope (FXT) was triggered and started from T_det+215 s, further localizing this uncataloged source to a position consistent with the galaxy SDSS J095942.88+002506.2 at a redshift of z=0.0344 (see Ref. [49])" -- adopted verbatim; no error and no reference frame is stated, so `frame` stays undeclared.  The paper attributes the number to its own Ref. [49], which was not read: the adoption is this paper's, and this paper was read in full.  Cross-checks, never inputs: the same paper elsewhere rounds it -- "For EP260321a at z=0.034 (luminosity distance D_L ~ 150 Mpc), we compute the maximum volume ..." -- and GCN 44070's title says "the z=0.034 galaxy"; the 0.0004 difference (1.2 % in z) changes no decision here.

distance.source: z = 0.0344 is above the 0.02 peculiar-velocity guard, so no `allow_low_z` flag is needed.  The paper's "D_L ~ 150 Mpc" follows from (its rounded) redshift under a cosmology that sentence does not state -- it is not an independent distance indicator, so `kind: measured` would be fiction; it is kept as the cross-check above (docs/VALIDATION.md) and never an input. The default cosmology is used and named in every result's provenance via `constants.DEFAULT_COSMOLOGY_NAME`.

citations: Yuan et al. 2026, "X-rays breaking out of pre-explosion ejecta mark a supernova's first light", arXiv:2606.10014v2.  Publisher of the vendored table (395 of 533 rows); the redshift sentence, the T_0/onset definitions, the Galactic-extinction sentence and the shock-breakout claim all come from it; read in full (S_OK).

Rastinejad et al. 2026, arXiv:2606.10011v2: publisher of the 118 rows appended to the vendored table (r 38, i 33, g 31, u 7, z 5, J 4, from IOO, LSST, SEDM, WINTER and ZTF).  They densify the follow-up rather than extend it -- 68152 ... 4291816 s, entirely inside the discovery table's own 2434.7 ... 6096314.9 s -- and on the same seconds-since-T_0 axis, which is why they concatenate into one table with no re-origining; they are also the only source of `u` in this table, and the only reason that band can be named in the registry map at all.  Accepted (ApJL) with no journal DOI assigned yet, so the arXiv identifier is the only one this repository asserts for it: writing the DOI arXiv mints for every paper it hosts would assert a publisher-assigned DOI this one does not have, and `tests/test_docs.py` pins that distinction.  Read in full.

GCN circulars 44070, 44081, 44084, 44087, 44089, 44091, 44105 and 44171 (18 rows) plus two blank reference cells: row-level provenance exactly as vendored; none was read, so none is cited for any decision: grade S_UNVER.
